terbaru.judul: SALPA: Spaceborne LiDAR Point Adjustment for Enhanced GEDI Footprint Geolocation
terbaru.pelajaran: We present SALPA (Spaceborne LiDAR Point Adjustment), a multi-algorithm optimization framework integrating three optimization paradigms with five distance metrics.

terbaru.judul: On the Interaction Between Chicken Swarm Rejuvenation and KLD-Adaptive Sampling in Particle Filters
terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze, under a simplified modeling framework, the effect of the CSO rejuvenation step on the particle set distribution.

terbaru.judul: AVOID-JACK: Avoidance of Jackknifing for Swarms of Long Heavy Articulated Vehicles
terbaru.pelajaran: To tackle this new class of swarm robotics problems, we propose a purely reaction-based, decentralized swarm intelligence strategy tailored to automate elongated, articulated vehicles.

terbaru.judul: A Meta-Cognitive Swarm Intelligence Framework for Resilient UAV Navigation in GPS-Denied and Cluttered Environments
terbaru.pelajaran: Inspired by principles of computational meta-cognition, this paper introduces a novel swarm intelligence framework that enables a fleet of UAVs to autonomously sense, adapt, and recover from planning failures in real-time.

terbaru.judul: Mean-Shift Theory and Its Applications in Swarm Robotics: A New Way to Enhance the Efficiency of Multi-Robot Collaboration
terbaru.pelajaran: Swarms evolving from collective behaviors among multiple individuals are commonly seen in nature, which enables biological systems to exhibit more efficient and robust collaboration.

terbaru.judul: Fortytwo: Swarm Inference with Peer-Ranked Consensus
terbaru.pelajaran: We present Fortytwo, a novel protocol that leverages swarm intelligence principles and distributed pairwise ranking consensus to achieve superior performance in AI inference.

terbaru.judul: PSO-XAI: A PSO-Enhanced Explainable AI Framework for Reliable Breast Cancer Detection
terbaru.pelajaran: Breast cancer is considered the most critical and frequently diagnosed cancer in women worldwide, leading to an increase in cancer-related mortality.

terbaru.judul: SwarmSys: Decentralized Swarm-Inspired Agents for Scalable and Adaptive Reasoning
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce SwarmSys, a closed-loop framework for distributed multi-agent reasoning inspired by swarm intelligence.

terbaru.judul: Autonomous Multi-Robot Infrastructure for AI-Enabled Healthcare Delivery and Diagnostics
terbaru.pelajaran: This research presents a multi-robot system for inpatient care, designed using swarm intelligence principles and incorporating wearable health sensors, RF-based communication, and AI-driven decision support.

terbaru.judul: Emerging Paradigms for Securing Federated Learning Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: Federated Learning (FL) facilitates collaborative model training while keeping raw data decentralized, making it a conduit for leveraging the power of IoT devices while maintaining privacy of the locally collected data.
